description:
A link to the venue's seating-chart image for one event: a static
diagram showing every section's shape and position relative to the
field or stage, color-coded by tier or level.

event_id: UPFRONT's event id (eventId in event results). The chart
belongs to the venue's seating layout, not the date, so the same
image serves every event there, including far-future events with no
tickets yet.

Returns {"mapImageUrl"} on success, {} when there is no chart for
this venue, or {"error": "search_failed"} when the lookup failed
after retries. In the last two cases no map is available.
name: get_seating_map
title: Seating chart
